description: This file is a shell script that sets up and tests Git pre-push hooks, verifying their behavior under various conditions such as successful pushes, failing hooks, bypassing hooks, branch and tag pushes, deletions, URL pushes, and large ref sets.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution of the enclosed commands.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to run after test completion for cleanup.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual and expected output files.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the enclosed command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks if a specified path is missing.

methods.name: test_hook
methods.description: Sets up or triggers Git hooks for testing.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit with a message.
